title: Prototype #1 Calibration — Updating Simulation Models from Measurements
description: Demonstrates the full measurement-to-model feedback loop: fitting free-air .zma, in-cabinet .zma, and 2pi ground-plane .frd measurements via Forward-Mode Dual-AD Bayesian MAP optimization to update driver T-S parameters and diagnose an accidental cabinet air leak.
design_notes: Automatic Build-Defect Diagnosis: The built prototype exhibited lower twin impedance peaks and 1.8 dB less output at 33 Hz than CAD predicted. Bayesian MAP calibration pinpointed an unsealed speakON/driver gasket leak (Posterior Q_L = 4.3 vs Design Q_L = 14.0) alongside +23% spider break-in compliance and -7.6% bracing displacement!
Uncertainty Quantification: Open the Calibration tab to inspect the Posterior 95% Laplace credible intervals and SVD parameter correlation matrix.

calibration.summary: 3-Stage Dual-AD Bayesian MAP Calibration (Free-Air Z + In-Box Z + 2pi Ground-Plane SPL)
diagnostics: Converged in 11 Trust-Region Levenberg-Marquardt iterations (exact Dual-AD Jacobian). SPL RMS residual dropped from 1.29 dB -> 0.06 dB.
CABINET LEAK DETECTED: Posterior Q_L = 4.30 (vs design Q_L = 14.0) — inspect driver gasket, speakON plate, or wood joints for air leaks!
Suspension Compliance Shift: C_ms changed +23.3% from datasheet prior (typical spider break-in / batch variance).
Effective Acoustic Volume V_b shifted -7.5% (134.1 L vs 145.0 L nominal — net effect of internal bracing displacement vs porous isothermal gain).
